name: TikTok Ads
description: Send online purchases to TikTok Ads from the server

images.title: Every online order, sent to TikTok
images.description: Each order placed through your storefront reaches TikTok as a Purchase, from the server, once.

images.title: Matched to the ad that sold it
images.description: Hashed customer details, plus the click id, Pixel cookie, IP and user agent your storefront hands over.

images.title: Nothing lost quietly
images.description: If TikTok refuses your token, your admins get an email, and the waiting purchases go out once it is fixed.

images.title: Set up in minutes
images.description: Paste your Pixel code and access token, test the connection, and switch it on.
